result.title: PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes
result.summary: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PLDiv，用 persistence landscapes 从数据的几何表示刻画结构多样性，将邻域随样本逐步连接而演化的过程汇总为可解释标量，无需任务监督，并在文本生成、图像嵌入、指令数据集与推理轨迹上评估其检测语义坍缩的能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以表示几何度量多样性并检测语义坍缩的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态或推理轨迹是否出现信息坍缩与多样性退化，但论文不涉及 VLM 推理机制或 latent 生成，迁移可行性需人工判断。
